video_title: I Took 2 Struggling Families On A $10,000 Back-To-School Shopping Spree!

quotes.speaker: Omar Carrenton
quotes.summary_phrase: Omar Carrenton explains his motivation for helping families in need
quotes.excerpt: my whole dream with everything I do is to become the hero that the little me once needed
quotes.quote: My whole dream with everything I do is to become the hero that the little me once needed. I remember what it was like not having nothing, hoping that something like this will happen soon. I remember what it was like to watch my mom struggle by herself, wanting to do anything she can. So if I can bring that joy to someone else, it's like healing that inner me. It's passed on the blessings that I wish I received as a young kid. So this means everything.
